rows: What controls where an element goes during melting?
Partition coefficient D; D>1 = compatible (stays in residue); D<1 = incompatible (enters melt)
Bulk Silicate Earth — mantle + crust; the non-core portion of Earth; used as a reference composition
Large Ion Lithophile Element (K, Rb, Cs, Sr, Ba, Pb, U, Th) — high charge, large radius, incompatible in most minerals → concentrated in crust
High Field Strength Element (Nb, Ta, Zr, Hf, Ti) — high charge/small radius ratio; immobile in fluids; depleted in subduction-zone magmas
What does the Nb-Ta depletion signature mean?
Characteristic of subduction zone (arc) magmas; HFSE retained in subducted slab; diagnostic of tectonic setting
Elemental concentrations to ppt level and isotope ratios (less precisely than TIMS); multi-element in one run
Composition close to CI chondrites (carbonaceous chondrites type CI) — best approximation of bulk solar system composition minus volatiles
